purpose: Teach: プライス/デイリー/タイムリー/コントラスト/不合格/日本経済新聞/レジスト/博覧

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、プライス戦略を独自に立てられた
lines.en: Dad set his own pricing strategy right from the start.
lines.style: Gentle, measured recollection. Slight pause before continuing—gathering a memory. Warm but distant, as though speaking to the person being remembered as much as to his son.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはデイリーで現場巡回された
lines.en: Yes. He walked the factory floor every single day.
lines.style: Steady affirmation. Firm respect on 「毎日」—not just routine, but commitment. Quiet, direct eye contact held. Voice carries the weight of understanding what that discipline meant.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、タイムリーな決断を貫かれた
lines.en: Dad held to his decisions when the timing was right. He never wavered.
lines.style: Soft, admiring tone with a catch of emotion underneath. Slight breathiness on the opening. Trailing off gently—this is a quality he still carries with him.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは商品の色コントラストを大事にされた
lines.en: Yes. He believed color and contrast in a product mattered deeply.
lines.style: Calm, deliberate. A small nod audible in the voice. Not listing facts—confessing something he's inherited. Slight emphasis on 「大事にされた」—this was a principle, not a preference.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、品質不合格を許されない方だった
lines.en: Dad never accepted poor quality. He simply wouldn't allow it.
lines.style: Quieter now, more intimate. A hint of reverence and a shadow of the standard he was held to. Slow delivery. Trailing slightly on the final thought, as if that standard still lives in him.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは日本経済新聞を朝必ず読まれた
lines.en: Yes. He read the Nikkei every morning without fail.
lines.style: Even pace, matter-of-fact but warm. A small smile in the voice—the kind of detail that reveals a man's whole life. Not lecturing, just witnessing the ritual.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、半導体レジスト技術にも投資された
lines.en: Dad invested in semiconductor resist technology too. He was always looking ahead.
lines.style: Gentle admiration. Slight lift on the opening—pride in the forward-thinking. Slow, thoughtful delivery. Fades softly, inviting the moment to breathe.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんが万国博覧会に出展された
lines.en: Yes. He exhibited our work at the World's Fair.
lines.style: Final statement: grounded, clear, and full of quiet dignity. A gentle close—not triumphant, but complete. The voice settles, as though this memory is the capstone of what he's been saying.
